# Discovered capabilities

Generated by `scripts/build_evolution_guides.py` using the actual `list_solvers()` interface. Availability is local installation evidence, not graph compatibility or performance. Eligibility additionally checks actual topology, integer scaling and guards before launch.

| Backend | Available | Actual warm-start interface | Work unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| exhaustive | True | retained_incumbent | assignments |
| bm | True | initial_refinement_center | configured complete passes |
| tabu | True | initial_state | iterations |
| bls | True | initial_state | individual flips |
| annealing | True | initial_state | proposals; bounded polish separate |
| lns | True | initial_state_and_fixed_boundary | neighborhoods |
| milp | True | native_complete_incumbent | branch_nodes |
| bsb | True | replica_zero_initialization_and_retention | integration_steps |
| dsb | True | replica_zero_initialization_and_retention | integration_steps |
| gsb | True | replica_zero_initialization_and_retention | integration_steps |
| sbqa | True | replica_zero_initialization_and_retention | integration_steps |
| tesb | True | warm_replica_zero_and_retention | total warm+checking integration_steps |
| mqlib | True | unsupported | None |
| scientific | True | native_partition_incumbent | branch_nodes |
| biqbin | True | unsupported | None |
| madam | True | unsupported | None |
| biqcrunch | True | unsupported | None |
| planar_matching | True | retention_only | connected_components |
| toroidal_bound | True | retention_only | one initial matching; no extra iterations |
| toroidal_search | True | initial_cycle_repair_state | additional cycle_repairs |
| qubowl | False | unavailable | None |

BiqBin and MADAM use actual fixed seed 2020, two MPI ranks and default 1024-node guards; BiqCrunch defaults to 5000 nodes. Exact scaling is checked without rounding weights. Toroidal matching/repair requires verified row-major square torus topology with side at least 3; the default 4096-expanded-vertex guard excludes the public side-100 and side-316 tori. Planar matching verifies planarity. No guard is raised automatically. QuBowl remains unavailable. The [read-only public plan](../../evidence/evolution/public_plan_only.json) records real eligible/excluded reasons for the inspected 1000-node signed-random graph; it is not a campaign.

Unsupported-start MQLib/BiqBin/MADAM/BiqCrunch remain fresh-start competitors. Retention-only matching methods do not perform a new state-dependent computation merely because a different incumbent was supplied. Bifurcation methods support only their actual documented warm replica. See [portfolio status](../portfolio/STATUS.md) and [source identities](../../evidence/evolution/baseline_identity.json).
